thesis: The podcast argues that China has surpassed the US as the global leader in biomedical innovation, producing a larger share of new therapies and medical devices since 2016. This shift is attributed to China running larger, better clinical trials that reduce false positives and negatives, alongside accelerated approvals and a regulatory system that prioritizes profitability for firms negotiating with the state.
